summary: Targeted backend+frontend chat/skills validation on external preview. Backend permission/mail-guard checks passed; consolidated desktop Playwright run is failing in real save_password approval chain and remains unstable for full completion.

In real chain run the generated password card ended in state 'Пароль больше не доступен' before save_password continuation was completed.

issues: Very long chat title still visually truncates in practical layout despite wrapping improvements (observed during failure screenshot).

Investigate why generated password ref can become unavailable before follow-up save step in same testing session.
